task.maid_smart.flight_combat.desc.en: Melee Air Raid: elytra + any melee weapon + firework rocket; jump-glide, launch a firework away+up, fly at the enemy after 1.5s, cancel gliding within 3.5 blocks to free-fall into a critical melee hit, then re-glide and repeat
task.maid_smart.flight_combat.desc.zh: 近战空袭：鞘翅 + 任意近战武器 + 烟花火箭。遇敌先起跳滑翔放烟花（初速=背离敌人+向上），1.5 秒后朝敌人飞，进入 3.5 格取消滑翔自由落体、触底前近战命中（暴击 ×1.5），命中后切回滑翔再放烟花循环；不响应自主切换
task.maid_smart.flight_combat.desc.vi: Melee Air Raid: elytra + any melee weapon + firework rocket; jump-glide, launch a firework away+up, fly at the enemy after 1.5s, cancel gliding within 3.5 blocks to free-fall into a critical melee hit, then re-glide and repeat

task.maid_smart.flight_ranged.desc.en: Ranged Air Raid: elytra + any ranged weapon + firework rocket (guns also need ammo that fits the held gun - the gun mod decides); launches like Melee Air Raid, then circles in the sky and shoots enemies within range with the held ranged weapon, refreshing a firework every 5s; lands after the enemy dies
task.maid_smart.flight_ranged.desc.zh: 远程空袭：鞘翅 + 任意远程武器 + 烟花火箭（用枪械时还要子弹喂得上那把枪，口径由枪械 mod 自己判）。起飞方式与近战空袭相同，随后持续在天上盘旋（类似幻翼）并用手中远程武器打锁敌范围内的敌人，每 5 秒补一枚烟花；击败敌人后落地；不响应自主切换
task.maid_smart.flight_ranged.desc.vi: Ranged Air Raid: elytra + any ranged weapon + firework rocket (guns also need ammo that fits the held gun - the gun mod decides); launches like Melee Air Raid, then circles in the sky and shoots enemies within range with the held ranged weapon, refreshing a firework every 5s; lands after the enemy dies

task.maid_smart.broom.desc.en: Broom: the maid takes a TLM broom out of her inventory, rides it herself (no player driver needed) and shoots with her held ranged weapon; when idle she hovers and follows her owner, and in home mode she patrols in a circle around the work area instead. Needs a broom + ranged weapon + ammo (for guns the ammo must fit the held gun - the gun mod itself decides, TACZ or Superb Warfare); if something is missing she waits in place and reports what is missing. Not used by auto task switching. While riding she can NOT cast magic or place TNT/end crystals/respawn anchors/beds - only her held weapon attacks
task.maid_smart.broom.desc.zh: 扫帚模式：女仆自己取出 TLM 的扫帚骑上去飞起来（无需玩家驾驶），用主手的远程武器开火；平时悬停在主人身边跟随，守家（工作范围）时改成沿着工作范围那个圈盘旋巡逻。需要扫帚 + 远程武器 + 弹药（弹药要喂得上手里那把枪——口径由枪械 mod 自己判：TACZ / 卓越前线都一样），缺件时原地待命并播报缺什么；不响应自主切换。因为是骑乘状态，这个模式下她**不能施法、也不能放 TNT/末地水晶/重生锚/床**，只有主手武器在打
task.maid_smart.broom.desc.vi: Broom: the maid takes a TLM broom out of her inventory, rides it herself (no player driver needed) and shoots with her held ranged weapon; when idle she hovers and follows her owner, and in home mode she patrols in a circle around the work area instead. Needs a broom + ranged weapon + ammo (for guns the ammo must fit the held gun - the gun mod itself decides, TACZ or Superb Warfare); if something is missing she waits in place and reports what is missing. Not used by auto task switching. While riding she can NOT cast magic or place TNT/end crystals/respawn anchors/beds - only her held weapon attacks

config.promaid.combat.snipe.en: High Ground Sniping (on by default): ranged attack state (manual/auto-assign both OK) + has building blocks + enemy closes in — enters elevated state: holds position (move speed ×0), instantly raises 5 blocks and attacks from a fixed spot; only affects movement, not attack; if auto-assigned and has a melee weapon, switches to melee first; teleport disabled during this; cancels when no enemies within radius 8 or self-preservation triggers; auto re-pads if the tower is blown down

config.promaid.build.noForceHome.vi: No forced home in build mode

config.promaid.build.noForceHome.tooltip.en: No forced home in build mode (default on): during building / marker-stone temporary construction she is no longer switched into home (garrison) mode. Instead the mod blocks every NON-player-willed auto-teleport at its source (TLM follow teleport / same-dimension long-range pullback / cross-dimension auto-follow / owner-death recall / self-preservation return), so she stays on the site. Manual summon, schedule 'teleport to me', stuck-rescue and the build's own teleport still work. Off = revert to old behavior (build forces home and swallows all auto-teleports).
config.promaid.build.noForceHome.tooltip.zh: 建造不强制 home（默认开）：建造/指标石临时搭建期间不再把她切成守家（home）模式，改为在源头拦下各处【非玩家意愿】的自动传送（TLM 跟随瞬移 / 同维远距拉回 / 跨维自动跟随 / 主人死亡归位 / 自保归位），她安心留在工地。一键集合、排班表「传送到我身边」、受困救援、建造自己的瞬移照常可用。关 = 回退旧行为（建造强制 home，自动传送照吃）
config.promaid.build.noForceHome.tooltip.vi: No forced home in build mode (default on): during building / marker-stone temporary construction she is no longer switched into home (garrison) mode. Instead the mod blocks every NON-player-willed auto-teleport at its source (TLM follow teleport / same-dimension long-range pullback / cross-dimension auto-follow / owner-death recall / self-preservation return), so she stays on the site. Manual summon, schedule 'teleport to me', stuck-rescue and the build's own teleport still work. Off = revert to old behavior (build forces home and swallows all auto-teleports).
